Subject: Re: URGENT: Asteria prod 429 spike — possible quota/tier misconfig (need immediate action)

Jordan / team —

Quick status and root-cause hypothesis: we've confirmed an org-level enforcement event. Preliminary findings:
- Asteria's org had a legacy per-project override that should have been promoted to the new tier when they moved to reserved capacity last quarter. During a config migration the project asteria-prod-batch retained a low per-project cap (50 rps) while other projects had a higher org-level allowance. When the batch job kicked off it exceeded the project cap and triggered org enforcement cascaded by our rate-limiter.
- The rate-limiter currently returns 429 without a Retry-After in some code paths; coupled with the customer's aggressive retry policy, this produced a retry storm.

Actions taken (completed):
- Temporarily raised the per-project cap for asteria-prod-batch to 500 rps at 09:40 PST (org override).
- Enabled Retry-After header on the affected limiter and toggled the soft-fail path to return 503 for heavy backpressure for 30 minutes while we stabilise.
- Created enhanced logs (samples attached) and pushed an alert to Grafana.

Next steps (in flight):
- Run a fast audit across recent config migrations for similar stale overrides (ETA 2h).
- Patch rate-limiter to include Retry-After on all quota responses (ETA 48h for rollout).
- Produce an internal incident summary and a customer-facing note.

I'll keep this thread updated. If Marissa wants to join the bridge for a customer touch, ping me and I'll join.

— Stephanie
Senior Tech Lead, Serving Runtime
